title: Tightness of the band-limited displacement bound

quantities.displacement_ratio: exact one-step displacement of the registered action divided by the band-limited bound (6.1), at states whose spectral energy density is proportional to exp(-lambda/lambda_0) on [0, 2] (ratio)

notes: Keys: action = registry identifier A1 ... A7; spectral_scale = lambda_0 of the state's spectral energy density. A ratio above one falsifies an assumption of main Proposition 6 for that plant. The displacement and bound arrays of every evaluated state go under raw/; deposit with `python -B scripts/export_records.py from-mapping --mapping <band_bound_tightness mapping>` once the set is registered for the mapping exporter.
